activity_summary: You went back for evening prayer. The parish was still in black. Master Thwaite added no sermon to the passion. You added nothing. You took no branch, and you brought no new matter home to a page.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood, added nothing, and kept the afternoon quiet.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Kept the evening to the prayer.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Refused a dressing-up and a new matter.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Said the ledge was still bare.

quotes.speaker: josias_thwaite
quotes.text: I will not add a sermon to a passion.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The afternoon was quiet. I am keeping it quiet.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: I did not bring the house out a second time to hear a new matter.
